Italy is beaten early, and the monarchy's last battles are fought elsewhere. What actually happened: Italy declared war on Austria-Hungary on 23 May 1915 and the Isonzo front was fought through eleven battles before the Austro-German victory at Caporetto in October 1917. The Trentino offensive of May 1916 took part of the Asiago plateau and was broken off when the Russians attacked in Galicia. The Italian army was reformed after Caporetto under Diaz and grew in strength through 1918, and the battle of Vittorio Veneto in October broke the Austro-Hungarian front.
